role: Opens the client's sign edit GUI at a sign's position.
scope_reason: world.conf sign_editing = off: signs are placed blank and the editor never opens.

members.name: S36PacketSignEditorOpen
members.note: the decoder's ctor only: Packet.generatePacket instantiates it by reflection (newInstance) for bytes read off a socket (MessageDeserializer); the integrated server's local channel passes packet objects with no codec (NetworkManager.provideLocalClient adds only the packet_handler), so it never runs

notes: The only sender is ItemSign.onItemUse through EntityPlayerMP.displayGUUpdateSignEditor (ItemSign.java:88, EntityPlayerMP.java:670), gated on netherite.oracle.WorldConf.signEditing.
